summary: Veru Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Sales Agreement with Oppenheimer & Co. Inc. and Canaccord Genuity LLC as sales agents for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering. The company may issue and sell up to $21.8 million of its common stock from time to time through agents using commercially reasonable efforts. Agents receive a 3.0% commission on gross proceeds and are not obligated to sell any shares. The offering is registered under an existing S-3 shelf effective April 15, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown arrangement for capital-raising purposes, not a special situation event.
